payload.title: Distinguish Docker registry port from explicit image tag in serving admission
payload.summary: P2: both serving configurations accept registry.example:5000/team/server although existing policy requires explicit tag or digest. A colon in registry port is not a tag in final image component. Repair local existing config admission; preserve server:cuda and server@sha256:<64hex> controls, unqualified/blank and other current validation. Probe only constructs configs, never Docker. An explicit mutable tag is not cryptographic model/image immutability. Baseline a7a49cc18f3b40a5bf4e3897ca30d9a5cddc30d1. Acceptance: Registry-port-only image refused before executor; same registry with explicit last-component tag or digest accepted; valid existing images unchanged; independent both-adapter configuration tests.
payload.benefit: Make the existing supported boundary conservative and reliable without inventing new lifecycle or authority.
payload.uncertainty: Deterministic maintained-call probes, not live model/GPU/Docker proof. Production correction is not authorized by this audit; preserve ownership and public compatibility.
dependencies: Existing ADR-0001 ModelInteraction/Serving ownership and current public error/JSON/config contracts; no new architectural approval implied.
